name: self_design_intervention_capacity
README_purpose: Compiled object: principle P_SDI — capacity to intervene on own design (Tegmark Life 1.0/2.0/3.0), measured on dual axes against type_by_function tiers (cellular/individual/social) without conflating scales; includes neuropsychology grounding chain, species climb hypothesis (P-status), and within-individual metacognition variance.
lens_mode: do not force-fit; prefer XOR/NAND disclosure over fake join

principle.raw: An organism's ability to intervene on its own design, scaling with complexity — along the lines of Max Tegmark Life 3.0 (Life 1.0 / 2.0 / 3.0).
principle.normalized_statement: Principle P_SDI: capacity of a system to intervene on its own design (hardware / software / both), graded by how much of its makeup it can knowingly rewrite rather than only inherit or undergo.
principle.domain_claimed: philosophy of life / AI futures / complexity — measured across biological–social tiers
principle.seeming_unrelated_note: Arrives via neuropsychology preamble; core is self-redesign capacity, not Gage itself.

Life_1_0.label: Biological evolution only
Life_1_0.design_intervention: Cannot redesign hardware or software during its lifetime; both set mostly by evolution

Life_2_0.label: Cultural
Life_2_0.design_intervention: Can redesign software (learning, culture, skills) but not hardware

Life_3_0.label: Technological
Life_3_0.design_intervention: Can redesign both software and hardware
examples_typical: hypothetical future AI / engineered life; partial human approaches via medicine/tech

tegmark_life_scale.do_not_conflate_with: Measurement tiers cellular / individual / social from type_by_function_isomorphism. Life 1/2/3 ≠ those three tiers.

relationship_hypothesis_operator.statement: Species-level tendency: as a lineage such as humans evolves (biologically, culturally, technologically), it tends to move upward on the Tegmark Life scale — Life 1.0 → 2.0 → 3.0 — increasing capacity to intervene on its own design.
relationship_hypothesis_operator.status: P-status hypothesis — directionally standard in Tegmark framing for humans (1→2 done; 2→3 contested/ongoing)
relationship_hypothesis_operator.not_the_claim: Not primarily: Life 3.0 appears first as a social superorganism then falls down onto individual humans (that was a misread of an earlier aside; kept only as a separate optional conjecture if revisited).

aside_misread_archived.old_read: Life 3 may arrive socially first then cascade down to individuals
aside_misread_archived.status: deprioritized — operator clarified species-upward climb is the intended claim

relationship_hypothesis_operator.lens_note: Upward climb is historical/tendency claim about a species trajectory, not identity of Life grades with cellular/individual/social tiers.

preamble_kept_as_grounding_not_principle: incompleteness; faith/will in the gap; enlightenment as variance reduction

within_tier_variance.statement: P_SDI is not only a species-level Life 1→2→3 climb. Inside a tier — especially individual humans as Life 2.0 — organisms differ in capacity to intervene on their own design, notably metacognition and ability to change their mind (rewrite software: beliefs, models, policies).
within_tier_variance.folk_observation: Humans routinely remark that some people update and some do not — everyday evidence of within-species variance.

maps_to.Life_scale: Usually still Life 2.0 (software rewrite); rare individuals push harder toward hardware self-design via tools/medicine — still not full species Life 3.0
maps_to.measurement_tier: individual (primary); social analogs = institutions that can/can't reverse doctrine
maps_to.grounding_chain: Use-dependent plasticity + mind–brain loop + enlightenment-as-variance-reduction = mechanisms/aims of high metacognitive self-intervention

score_hint.individual_tier_refinement: Keep tier capacity 'strong' as species-typical ceiling; add a within-tier spread from weak→constitutive for metacognitive self-redesign among persons

do_not_conflate: Individual mind-change ability ≠ Tegmark Life number of the species

records.summary: Subjective world as brain-constructed model of objective world; brain in objective world; two-way mind–brain coupling; model incomplete.

observed.evidence: Constructive perception + plasticity; completeness claim rejected

records.summary: Hard incompleteness of subjective map; free will & faith as gap occupants (P-status); enlightenment = variance reduction internal↔external.
P_SDI locked: self-design intervention capacity (Tegmark Life 1/2/3); measure across cellular/individual/social without conflating scales.

measurement_frame.what_is_measured: Capacity of the principle = how strongly / widely it can operate, bind, or be expressed at each tier, and across which function-ids — without collapsing tiers.

score_meaning.none: No honest expression at this tier
score_meaning.latent: Could apply only by stretched analogy
score_meaning.weak: Present but thin or easily fake
score_meaning.constitutive: Tier barely makes sense without it

cellular.life_scale_notes: Dominant: design set by evolution; cell does not knowingly rewrite its hardware. Limited adaptive 'software' (gene regulation, habituation) is not full Life 2.0 culture. Rare edge: HGT, CRISPR-like systems — still not Tegmark-style agentic redesign.
cellular.expression: Homeostatic and plastic adjustments; almost no intentional self-reengineering of body-plan mid-life.
cellular.notes: Basal cognition ≠ Life 3.0. Do not promote cells to 2.0/3.0 on rhyme alone.

individual.life_scale_notes: Classic Tegmark human: redesign skills, beliefs, culture (software). Hardware intervention partial via medicine, prosthetics, lifestyle — approaching but not full Life 3.0.
individual.expression: Learning + culture rewrite policy; surgery/pharma/tools rewrite substrate incompletely; mind–brain loop + plasticity are the mechanisms.
individual.partial_Life_3_0: moderate latent — gene editing, BCIs, radical prosthetics as emerging hardware self-design

within_tier_spread.low_end: rigid — low update under evidence; weak software self-design in practice
within_tier_spread.high_end: high metacognition — monitors own model, revises; strong software self-design within Life 2.0

social.life_scale_notes: Collectives rewrite law, tech stacks, cities, supply chains — 'hardware' of the social body — plus norms/media as software. Often more Life-3-shaped than a single human, while still not a biological organism.
social.expression: Institutions and markets redesign their own infrastructure and protocols; science/tech as self-modification engines.
social.notes: Social 'hardware' is metaphor-heavy — mark resemble until a do-operator is specified. Supports operator hypothesis as P-status.

operator_hypothesis_species_climb.read: Humans already moved 1→2 (culture/learning); 2→3 is the live frontier (hardware self-design).

within_individual_variance.read: Species may sit at Life 2.0 while persons vary widely in actual software self-intervention capacity.

neuropsychology_general.statement: Neuropsychology studies how mental functions and behavior depend on the structure and activity of the nervous system, especially by linking specific deficits or changes in behavior to damage, disease, or disruption in particular brain systems.
neuropsychology_general.core_method: Lesion / dissociation logic: if region R is compromised and capacity C reliably changes, R is implicated in C (with caveats about networks, diaschisis, and compensation).
what_it_is_not: Not proof that only the brain ever adapts (basal competence still real elsewhere)
Not full identity of mind with tissue — it is mapping dependencies
neuropsychology_general.tie_to_measurement_frame: At the individual tier, neuropsychology is a primary instrument for scoring which functions (F-ids) depend on neural hubs vs distributed body systems — relevant when a principle's capacity is later measured across cellular / individual / social.

case_phineas_gage.agent: Railroad tamping iron (often miscited as rebar)
case_phineas_gage.trajectory: Iron entered the left side of the face (cheek / under the eye region), passed behind the eye, through frontal lobe tissue, and exited the top of the skull.
case_phineas_gage.historical_claim: He survived; reports described marked changes in personality, judgment, and social conduct — early evidence associating frontal / prefrontal systems with behavior regulation and social self.
case_phineas_gage.scientific_role: Canonical early case for brain–behavior association via focal injury: a specific region disabled → measurable behavioral change.
caveats: Contemporary retellings often exaggerate or simplify the personality story
Exact lesion reconstruction has been revised with modern imaging of his skull
Single case ≠ complete map; networks and recovery matter
Localization evidence ≠ cerebrocentric exclusivity over all adaptive function

use_dependent_plasticity.statement: Beyond loss-of-function mapping: nervous tissue is use-sensitive. Patterns of activity change connection strength and, over time, can enlarge or refine the tissue resources devoted to a practiced function (representational expansion / remodeling).

hebbian_core.rule_of_thumb: Cells that fire together wire together (Hebb, 1949) — correlated activity strengthens synapses between them.
hebbian_core.scope: Synaptic learning rule / dialect for how local circuits store use; not the entire story of every plastic change.
hebbian_core.not_identical_to: Macroscopic 'the whole lobe grew because of growth hormone' as a single cause

mechanisms_bundle_accurate: Neurovascular coupling: active regions draw more blood flow / metabolic support
Neurotrophic signaling (e.g. BDNF and related factors) — often mislabeled casually as 'growth hormones'
In some systems: gliovascular support, myelination changes, limited adult neurogenesis in specific niches
Map expansion / cortical territory shifts with skilled practice (classic sensorimotor examples)
use_dependent_plasticity.pop_compression_user_voiced: Exercise a region-by-function → more coordination + perfusion + growth-factor milieu → tissue resources for that function increase. Directionally right; mechanism is a bundle, not one hormone dial.
use_dependent_plasticity.link_to_gage_logic: Lesion: remove tissue → lose function (dependency map). Plasticity: work a function → change tissue (use map). Together they bookend brain–behavior coupling at the individual tier — still not cerebrocentric exclusivity over all life.

tier_hints_for_later_principle_scoring.cellular: latent–moderate analogs: activity-dependent gene expression, receptor trafficking, cytoskeletal remodeling under use
tier_hints_for_later_principle_scoring.individual: strong home of Hebbian + map plasticity evidence
tier_hints_for_later_principle_scoring.social: resemble only unless warranted: 'practice institutions grow capacity' is analogy until a do-operator is shown

caveats: Not all practice produces beneficial growth; maladaptive plasticity exists
Adult cortical 'growth' is often representational/microstructural more than gross organ enlargement
Gage showed loss mapping; plasticity literature is a later, broader program — do not anachronistically fuse them into one discovery

subjective_objective_mind_brain.statement: For human psychology: the brain sits in objective reality and receives sensory drive from it; it reprojects / constructs a subjective inner world — a working model of that outside. Subjective experience is carried in the operation of the brain; the brain itself is an object among objects. That yields a two-way causal coupling between mind and brain.

direction_A_world_to_mind.label: Object → senses → neural construction → subject
direction_A_world_to_mind.content: Exteroception and interoception supply constraints; cortex and allied systems build a scene, self, and meanings — not a raw dump of the world.

direction_B_mind_to_brain.label: Subject → use / attention / intention → tissue change + action
direction_B_mind_to_brain.content: Mental activity is neural activity; practiced, attended, or chosen patterns change synapses and maps (plasticity) and drive behavior back into the objective world.

two_way_link.claim: Mind and brain are coupled both ways: no subject without brain process in normal human psychology; brain process is reshaped by what the subject does and undergoes.
two_way_link.philosophical_status: Operational coupling claim for measurement — not a settled metaphysics (identity vs dual-aspect vs property dualism left open).

tightening.not_a_complete_picture: The brain does not deliver a complete, veridical copy of objective reality; it delivers an adaptive, partial, theory-laden model. Illusions, neglect, confabulation, and Gage-class personality change show the model can shear from the world and from prior self.
tightening.not_disembodied_mind_steering_meat: Mind-to-brain is not magic remote control; it is brain dynamics affecting brain dynamics (and body), described at the psychological grain.
tightening.not_cerebrocentric_about_all_life: This loop is strongest as an individual-tier human account; it does not erase basal competence elsewhere.

tier_hints_for_later_principle_scoring.cellular: moderate for local sensorimotor loops / molecular representation; weak for 'subjective world' language
tier_hints_for_later_principle_scoring.social: resemble: shared worlds, institutions as externalized models — earn transmit separately

chain_so_far: 2. Use map: exercise ↔ plastic change (Hebb / neurotrophic–vascular support)
3. Loop map: objective world ↔ brain construction ↔ subjective world, coupled both ways

incompleteness.statement: There is no way for the subjective mind to absolutely, completely, and accurately map objective reality. The inner model is always partial, lagging, theory-laden, and error-prone.
incompleteness.lens_note: Matches earlier rejection of 'complete picture'; now stated as hard limit, not a temporary bug.

free_will.role_in_operator_framing: Where the map cannot dictate a unique necessary next move from a full world-model, choice / will operates in underdetermination.
free_will.status: P-status framing — live philosophical dispute; kept as operator placement of will in the gap, not proven libertarianism

faith.role_in_operator_framing: Where the map cannot close, commitment beyond current evidence or proof holds a stance (trust, vow, axiom held without full derivation).
faith.status: P-status framing — not identical to Gen 17 covenant; may later XOR or resemble CF1 — do not auto-merge
faith.caveat: Faith-as-gap-commitment ≠ automatic warrant for any practice (see CF1 hygiene if crossed later)

enlightenment_process.statement: Enlightenment, in this framing, is the process of reducing variance between the internal model and the external world (operator phrasing: 'external model' — treated as outer reality / its structure, not a second ghost map unless specified).
enlightenment_process.operational_read: Shrink systematic error, blind spots, and slogan-covers between what is modeled inside and what constrains from outside.
not_identical_to: Mere certainty increase without contact with the outer
links_back: Lesion maps show which tissue supports which model functions when they fail
Use-dependent plasticity is how practice rewrites the model-substrate
Two-way loop is the arena where variance is noticed and reduced (or increased)

tier_hints_for_later_principle_scoring.cellular: weak–moderate: error-correction / feedback (homeostasis) as proto variance-reduction; 'faith/will' language usually latent
tier_hints_for_later_principle_scoring.individual: strong–constitutive home of incompleteness, will/faith-in-the-gap, enlightenment-as-variance-reduction
tier_hints_for_later_principle_scoring.social: moderate resemble: science, law, audit as collective variance-reduction; ideology as variance-increase — earn per case

3. Loop map: objective world ↔ brain construction ↔ subjective world
4. Gap map: no complete map; will & faith occupy underdetermination; enlightenment = reduce internal↔external variance

lens_pass.mode: human_summary_plus_residue — not full I10 vector dump

coherent_chain.claim: Systems differ in capacity to intervene on their own design (knowingly rewrite makeup vs only inherit/undergo).
Tegmark Life 1.0/2.0/3.0 grades that capacity: evolve-only → rewrite software → rewrite software and hardware.
Where a system sits (cellular/individual/social) is a separate axis from how much self-design it has (Life grade). Do not conflate.
First scores: cellular weak≈1.0; individual strong≈2.0 (+partial 3.0 latent); social strong mixed 2.0–3.0 (social 'hardware' still resemble-heavy).
Lineages such as humans tend to climb Life numbers over evolutionary/cultural/technological time (1→2 clear; 2→3 frontier).
Inside individual Life 2.0, persons differ in metacognition / mind-change — software self-intervention spread, not a different Life number.
How humans do much of that software rewrite: lesion dependency (Gage), use-dependent plasticity (Hebb/support milieu), subjective model loop in an objective brain.

The inner model never completely maps the outer world; will and faith operate in underdetermination; enlightenment-as-variance-reduction is one directed form of software self-intervention — subset of P_SDI, not identical to it.

mutual_coherence_checks.note: Gage/Hebb/loop explain mechanisms at individual tier; they do not entail Tegmark taxonomy or species climb. Preamble supports, does not prove, P_SDI.
Dual-axis rule holds; object already forbids smash.
Climb = species trajectory/ceiling band; metacognition = variance inside the band.
Collective tech/law rewrite can look Life-3-shaped while persons remain Life 2.0; only if social 'hardware' is not silently equated to biological body.
Hardware self-design does not require a complete world map; redesign under uncertainty is allowed.
Enlightenment framing is a purpose-directed software self-intervention. P_SDI also covers hardware and non-enlightenment redesign (including maladaptive).
Faith/will can enable commitment to update OR lock the model against update. Gap occupants are ambivalent for P_SDI — not automatic allies of metacognition.
Dependency maps for human neural functions ≠ all adaptive competence is neural.
